Bandham Tamil Movie Songs HD, Aatha Aatha Patha Patha Video Song featuring Anand Babu, Kajal Kiran and Sivaji Ganesan on Mango Music Tamil. Music composed by Shankar Ganesh, directed by K. Vijayan and produced by Anandavalli Balaji.
Song: Aatha Aatha Patha Patha
Singers: SPB
Lyrics: Pulamaipithan, Vaali
Bandham Tamil Movie also stars Shalini, Jaishankar and Manorama among others.
